# Hasherezade blog — post index

Index of selected posts from hasherezade's blog (https://hshrzd.wordpress.com/), author of PE-bear, PE-sieve, and libpeconv. This file lists titles, URLs, and dates with a short topic summary only. Fetch the full post from its URL on demand.

## [Flare-On 12 – Task 8](https://hshrzd.wordpress.com/2025/11/25/flare-on-12-task-8/)
